acceptance: One-session runs use versioned query order, parameters, warmup, cache, repetition, and optional workload-gap policies.
Timing includes planning, execution, and full result consumption and excludes declared setup phases.
Every timing is joined to its rendered SQL, data state, oracle result, and cohort identity.
Candidate score evidence uses complete repetitions, median atomic measures, published dispersion, and no best-run selection.
JOB and the qualified TPC-Havoc panel can run in Power while preserving their canonical dataset and equivalence contracts.
Failures invalidate score evidence and remain distinguishable from unsupported capabilities.
context: Implements the proposed cross-benchmark score architecture. Preserve official TPC metrics as separate outputs. The ADR's numerical weights, size vectors, concurrency points, and M4 reference are pilot hypotheses until the methodology-freeze item closes.
description: Build deterministic one-session orchestration for the admitted Power workload. Reuse the run service, monotonic timing, result capture, validation, and manifest contracts; record full result consumption and diagnostics without altering official TPC paths.
